streams.summary: For eligible recent international graduates whose education and job offer align with the province’s currently listed occupations.

substreams.name: Skilled Work Experience in Nova Scotia

substreams.name: Physicians
substreams.summary: For eligible physicians with an approved Nova Scotia health authority opportunity and a provincial Letter of Interest.

streams.name: Atlantic Immigration Program
streams.summary: A federal employer-driven pathway for eligible skilled foreign workers and international graduates with a designated Nova Scotia employer.

streams.name: Atlantic Immigration Program

substreams.name: Stream 2: Intermediate and Manual Skills
substreams.summary: For eligible workers in FEER 3, 4 or 5 occupations.

substreams.name: Stream 3: Regulated Professions
substreams.summary: For eligible workers whose intended profession is regulated in Québec.

substreams.name: Stream 4: Exceptional Talent
substreams.summary: For eligible applicants with recognized exceptional talent or an achievement identified by the Ministère.

streams.name: Québec Experience Program (PEQ)

streams.name: Business Immigration Programs

substreams.name: Innovative Business
substreams.summary: For an innovative business or project supported by an accompanying organization.

substreams.name: Business Start-up
substreams.summary: For applicants starting a business or operating a business already started in Québec.

substreams.name: Business Takeover
substreams.summary: For applicants taking over and operating an existing Québec business with support from an organization.

substreams.name: Investor Program
substreams.summary: For eligible investors who meet Québec’s management, net-worth, investment and French-language requirements.

substreams.name: Self-Employed Worker Program
substreams.summary: For eligible self-employed workers who intend to practise their profession in Québec.
